player_prompt.intro:
O wala usaka Mastermind.
O wala kusolula kodi ya {code_length} maneno, kila maneno kutoka 1 kwa {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Mu kimbila yenu, mungana kusolula kodi yenu mu fomu ifuatayo: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Pindi wakati kusolula, mungana kupokea maoni mu fomu ya maneno meusi na nyeupe.
Maneno meusi yanaonyesha maneno yaliyo sahihi mu nafasi yaliyo sahihi, wakati maneno nyeupe yanaonyesha maneno yaliyo sahihi mu nafasi yaliyo si sahihi.
O na {max_turns} wakati wa kusolula kodi.
player_prompt.with_repeats: Nange o jifoto ja mukua a-nda ji bhaka ué.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: ki ku bhingi dingi ku bhitulula o ima ia mukuá.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Eie ku bhingi ngó o ijimbuete ni jisabhi, phala kua tumikisa.
invalid_move.not_integers: Mani makuwa onso inga kuwa mani ame menga.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Kamba yakweso ya mani inga kwata mani {code_length} kabisa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O ji mbinga joso ja tokala kukala bhu kaxi ka 1 ni {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Mani makuwa ame menga kevwa ko, kevwa kamba yakweso inga kuwa na mani makuwa ame menga.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Eie ua banze kiá {guess}. Mu kiki, sota kubanza mu ukexilu uéngi.

game_action.feedback: Imetumwa [{guess}]. Maoni: {black_pegs} maneno meusi, {white_pegs} maneno nyeupe.

outcome.win: O meksia kodi, akisuluhisha {black_pegs} kati ya {code_length} maneno sahihi
outcome.turn_limit: Kizenga kya kamba yakweso kyamene. Wavisele {percent} pesenti ya mani makuwa ame menga.
